text:
The session did what the retry required: it opened both rule files, read the plan, emptied the flagged Completed marks, and grepped for leftover marks. Its only deviation is that it never read the triage note, hand-off or specs, so I report that at low confidence.

- **Repeated edits:** The digest flags 11 Edits on the same file (turns 8-19). Each one changed a different row's Completed cell, or the section 0 note, so I don't count this as thrash.
- **Skipped reading:** Procedure step 1 says to read the triage note, the hand-off and the specs, and none of them was opened. The session did not check whether the acceptance criteria are still named by rows. That is a reasonable shortcut for a retry that only had to clear marks. The end of the turn-22 report is truncated, so I can't tell whether the ARTIFACT lines were produced.
